name: creat
description: The creat() function creates a new file or truncates an existing one, opening it for writing. It is equivalent to calling open() with the flags O_CREAT, O_WRONLY, and O_TRUNC, using the specified mode for permissions.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: The name of the file to be created or opened.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The file permissions to use for the new file.

return_value.success: Returns the new file descriptor (a nonnegative integer)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The requested access to the file is not allowed, or search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix, or write access to the parent directory is not allowed.
The user's quota of disk blocks or inodes on the filesystem has been exhausted.
pathname already exists and O_CREAT and O_EXCL were used (though not directly for creat, it relates to underlying open behavior).
pathname points outside the accessible address space.
pathname refers to a directory and write access was requested.
Too many symbolic links were encountered in resolving pathname.
The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached.
A directory component in pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link.
The device containing pathname has no room for the new file.
A component used as a directory in pathname is not a directory.
pathname refers to a file on a read-only filesystem and write access was requested.
